detailed_description: This JSON-to-XML converter transforms hierarchical JSON data structures into valid XML documents by mapping key-value pairs to element nodes, array values to sequential tags, and nested objects to child elements. The tool employs a recursive descent parser to process JSON syntax, converting primitive types (strings, numbers, booleans) into text nodes while preserving complex structures through XML namespace declarations and CDATA encapsulation for special characters. Developers require this tool when integrating modern JSON-based APIs with legacy systems requiring XML input, such as enterprise EDI platforms, Java-based configuration frameworks, or document management systems using XSLT processing. The conversion engine supports advanced XML features including DTD schema generation, attribute-value encoding, and customizable root element definitions. During processing, the tool normalizes JSON arrays into XML collections using pluralization rules (e.g., "items" → <item>), handles date-time values via ISO 8601 formatting, and maintains document order through SAX parser implementation. Security features include schema validation against provided XSD definitions and automatic escaping of invalid XML characters like '<' and '&'. The output XML maintains strict well-formedness compliance using Unicode normalization checks and balanced tag closure verification.
usage_steps: Paste valid JSON into the syntax-highlighted textarea, with real-time validation feedback
Enter a custom root element name in the 'XML Root' field (default: <root>)
Toggle 'Array Pluralization' to enable automatic singular tag generation for array elements
Select 'Attribute Encoding' mode to convert key-value pairs into XML attributes instead of child nodes
Enable 'Pretty Print' with indentation level selector (2-8 spaces) for human-readable formatting
Download result as .xml file or copy formatted XML from the preview panel
